title: frankenia salina
intro: Frankenia salina, commonly known as ashwagandha of the Mediterranean, is a perennial succulent plant that belongs to the Frankeniaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Frankenia salina are attributed to its adaptogenic and anti-inflammatory properties, which may also help to alleviate symptoms of depression and arthritis. Bioactive constituents found in Frankenia salina include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
